_readme: Machine setup. Change these once, then forget them. policy.json is the file you actually play with.

mxc._note: binDir is the folder that contains <arch>\wxc-exec.exe. The shipped value is the copy of the MXC executables that travels with CastleKeep, in bin\ - see bin\README.md. Point it elsewhere, or set exePath, if you want a different build. MXC_BIN_DIR also works.

lemonade._note: Lemonade Server runs on the HOST and is never sandboxed. The agent loop talks to it directly. baseUrl is probed for both /api/v1 and /v1 style routes.
lemonade._model_note: Must match a model Lemonade has INSTALLED, exactly. /api/v1/models is the installed list; ?show_all=true is the catalogue, and a name can be in the catalogue and still 404 because nobody pulled it. Use workshop\models.py rather than typing a name from memory.
lemonade._thinking_note: false asks the model to skip its reasoning channel. Leave it off: a reasoning model will happily call the right tools, read the right file, work out the right answer and write every word of it into reasoning, emitting no reply at all - which looks exactly like the sandbox having eaten the answer. Set it to true to watch that happen, or null to take the server's default.

base._note: The always-on base agent. Every syncIntervalSec it checks whether anything in vault\*\invites or vault\*\outbox has changed - a free host-side stat - and if so spawns ONE real sandbox under policies\base.json to merge it. The check decides when to ask; policies\base.json decides what it is allowed to see. Raise this if the run log is too busy to read; it is not a security knob.

vault._note: Where the four persona agents live, one sealed folder each. Seeded on first run from core\vault.py and not in git.
